# Dependencies for the Josh docs builder (docs/build).
#
# Pinned to exact versions so a docs build is reproducible. Transitive dependencies are pinned too,
# so this file is the complete install set; regenerate it with:
#
#   docs/build/.venv/bin/pip freeze | grep -viE "^pip==|^setuptools==" > docs/build/requirements.txt
#
# The builder is NOT part of the engine build and is deliberately not baked into the container
# image. Install it on demand:
#
#   python3 -m venv docs/build/.venv
#   docs/build/.venv/bin/pip install -r docs/build/requirements.txt
#
# CI runners already provide python3, so the docs job only needs the pip install step above.

# Direct dependencies ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Jinja2==3.1.6                 # page templates, incl. the shared base.html
markdown-it-py==4.2.0         # Markdown -> HTML (replaces pandoc for the docs tree)
mdit-py-plugins==0.6.1        # Markdown extensions (admonitions, anchors)
pydantic==2.13.4              # front-matter schema with author-facing error messages
pytest==9.1.1                 # tests for the builder
PyYAML==6.0.3                 # parses front-matter, reporting the line it objected to
ruff==0.16.0                  # lint and format the builder

# Transitive dependencies ------------------------------------------------------------------------
annotated-types==0.8.0
iniconfig==2.3.0
MarkupSafe==3.0.3
mdurl==0.1.2
packaging==26.2
pluggy==1.6.0
pydantic_core==2.46.4
Pygments==2.20.0
typing-inspection==0.4.2
typing_extensions==4.16.0
